tests.name: Accept configured 60 percent standalone sale factor
Reject sale factor above the allowed range
Locate real Stardock and prepare active ship plus replacement

data.sql: WITH yard AS (SELECT p.port_id, p.sector_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt ON pt.porttype_id = p.porttype_id WHERE pt.is_stardock = TRUE ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1), moved AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM yard) WHERE name = 'ship_sale_v3' RETURNING player_id, ship_id), active AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM yard), ported = (SELECT port_id FROM yard), ore = 1, mines = 1, limpets = 1, probes = 1, photons = 1, beacons = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM moved) RETURNING ship_id, type_id, sector_id), replacement AS (INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, sector_id, holds, fighters, shields) SELECT 'Sale replacement V3', type_id, sector_id, 10, 0, 0 FROM active RETURNING ship_id), ownership AS (INSERT INTO ship_ownership (ship_id, player_id, role_id, is_primary) SELECT replacement.ship_id, moved.player_id, 1, TRUE FROM replacement CROSS JOIN moved RETURNING ship_id) SELECT yard.port_id, active.ship_id, ownership.ship_id FROM yard CROSS JOIN active CROSS JOIN ownership;

tests.name: Sell active hull and settle sale atomically
Verify active replacement, cargo forfeiture and used inventory persistence

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.ship_id = @{sale_test_replacement_ship_id} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, s.ore, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_cargo c WHERE c.ship_id = @{sale_test_active_ship_id}), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory u WHERE u.ship_id = @{sale_test_active_ship_id} AND u.port_id = @{sale_test_port_id}), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_ownership o WHERE o.ship_id = @{sale_test_active_ship_id}), CASE WHEN p.credits = @{sale_test_updated_credits} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (SELECT proceeds FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE sale_id = @{sale_test_sale_id}) = @{sale_test_proceeds} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id = @{sale_test_active_ship_id} WHERE p.name = 'ship_sale_v3';

tests.name: Sale proceeds use the integer-floor approved valuation formula

data.sql: SELECT ((hull_valuation + equipment_valuation) * sale_factor_bp) / 10000 FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE sale_id = @{sale_test_sale_id};

tests.name: Used inventory hull cannot be taken through abandoned-hull claim
Create second hull for shipyard.sell alias

data.sql: WITH player AS (SELECT player_id, ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'ship_sale_v3'), active AS (SELECT s.type_id, s.sector_id FROM ships s JOIN player p ON p.ship_id = s.ship_id), yard AS (SELECT p.port_id, p.sector_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt ON pt.porttype_id = p.porttype_id WHERE pt.is_stardock = TRUE ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1), hull AS (INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, sector_id, ported, holds, fighters, shields) SELECT 'Alias sale hull V3', active.type_id, yard.sector_id, yard.port_id, 10, 0, 0 FROM active CROSS JOIN yard RETURNING ship_id), owner AS (INSERT INTO ship_ownership (ship_id, player_id, role_id, is_primary) SELECT hull.ship_id, player.player_id, 1, TRUE FROM hull CROSS JOIN player RETURNING ship_id) SELECT ship_id FROM owner;
